tasks.title: Lock the value-first landing message
tasks.objective: Translate the approved landing direction and familiar illustrative cohort examples into concise canonical product copy and interaction requirements.
write_scope: issue-local notes when a wording decision needs evidence
authority: Lead with the benefit of finding a few people who will show up.
Use a compact, clearly illustrative set of familiar cohort examples to make the concept immediately concrete.
Explain 2 credits to create, 1 to join, credits returned if the group does not form, and 2 signup credits without ledger jargon.
Keep the examples and explanation compact enough to scan as part of the first landing experience.
acceptance_criteria: The canonical UI contract contains the approved landing-message hierarchy, illustrative-example treatment, and all four credit facts.
Examples span recognizable uses and cannot be mistaken for live cohort records.
Copy does not imply a subscription, guaranteed group formation, or a change to existing credit behavior.
verification: Review the proposed copy against the credit, quorum, and expiry contracts.
Confirm the copy remains understandable without reading another page.
tasks.stop_condition: Stop when the canonical copy and hierarchy are explicit enough to implement without inventing product behavior.

tasks.title: Implement and verify the landing message
tasks.objective: Render the approved value-first message, familiar illustrative cohort examples, and compact credit explanation on the landing page.
write_scope: focused landing, launch, and responsive tests
authority: Preserve the existing Create and Browse destinations.
Use plain language, small illustrative examples, and progressive disclosure rather than adding a tutorial.
Label examples so they are not represented as live or currently forming cohorts.
Preserve HTML escaping, semantics, focus visibility, and mobile layout.
acceptance_criteria: A first-time visitor can identify the product value and connect it to familiar example cohorts before acting.
The same first landing experience explains the create/join costs, says unsuccessful groups return credits, and says new accounts begin with 2 credits.
Illustrative examples are visually distinct from the live cohort listing.
Desktop and mobile layouts remain readable without horizontal overflow.
verification: Run focused landing and Piece of Pie launch tests.
Run desktop and mobile browser smoke for the landing page.
tasks.stop_condition: Stop when the approved message is visible, tested, and responsive without changing credit mechanics.
